events.title: Civil Service Board Meeting
events.description:
The City of York Civil Service Commission will hold public meetings for the purpose of reviewing rules and regulations and other such issues that come before the Commission on the fourth Tuesday of each month in 2025.
Meetings start at 5:30 pm and are held in York City Hall, Former Bank Space Conference Room, located at 101 S. George Street, 1st floor, York PA 17401. Any notice of cancellation of a meeting will be posted at York City Hall.

events.location: Council Chambers, 101 S George St, York, PA, 17401, United States
events.description: If you are a person with a disability and plan to attend the public meeting, please call (717) 849-2246 if any accommodations are needed to participate in the proceedings. events.title: Redevelopment Authority Meeting
events.location: Council Chambers, 101 S George St, York, PA, 17401, United States
events.description:
Notice is hereby given that the Redevelopment Authority of the City of York (RDA) will conduct its regular public meetings for the transaction of general business on the third Wednesday of every month at 4:00 PM from January 2026 through December 2026 in City Council Chambers, 101 South George Street, York, PA. 
All are open public meetings to which members of the public are invited to attend. 
Note: If you are a person with a disability and wish to attend these meetings and require any accommodations to participate, please contact DECD at 717-849-2264. Persons with hearing impairments may contact the Deaf Center at TTD 717-848-6765.

events.title: 2026 CAY 43rd Annual Cultural Thanksgiving Celebration
events.description:
Join Crispus Attucks York for our 43rd Annual Cultural Thanksgiving Celebration & Rising STARS Award Ceremony — a FREE community event celebrating the people who make a lasting, positive impact on the lives of our youth. 
Enjoy an evening filled with entertainment, food, awards, and community! 
📅 Monday, November 23, 2026🚪 Doors Open: 5:30 PM⭐ Program Begins: 6:00 PM🎤 Entertainment | Food | Awards🎟️ FREE Community Event 
Children must be accompanied by an adult. 
📞 For more information, contact:Jacquie Martino-Miller — 717-848-3610 ext. 262📧 jmartino@crispus-attucks.org 
Laquetta Coates📧 lcoates@crispusattucks.org 
Come celebrate with us as we recognize community, culture, gratitude, and those who continue to Give Rise to Possible! 
#CulturalThanksgiving #RisingSTARS #CrispusAttucksYork #YorkPA #Community #GiveRiseToPossible

events.title: 2026 Giving Tuesday: Crispus Attucks York
events.description:
GIVE THE GIFT OF POSSIBLE
Celebrating 95 Years. Investing in Our Children’s Futures.
Every child deserves the opportunity to learn, grow, discover their talents, and dream BIG! 
This Giving Tuesday, help Crispus Attucks York (CAY) open doors to meaningful educational experiences that inspire confidence, creativity, and brighter futures. 
HONOR OUR HISTORY. INVEST IN THEIR FUTURE.
For 95 years, CAY has made a difference in the lives of generations. Help us continue that legacy by investing in the next generation. 
OUR GOAL: $20,000 
100% of funds raised will support CAY’s educational programs for children and families. 
More than 1 in 4 children in York City lives in poverty.* Your gift helps provide opportunities that might otherwise be out of reach. 
EVERY GIFT MAKES POSSIBLE A BRIGHTER FUTURE!
Give Today. Make a Difference. Invest in Our Children. 
Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020–2024 American Community Survey estimates, as compiled by Neilsberg. 
Together, We Give Rise to Possible! 💙💛🩵 
#GivingTuesday #CrispusAttucksYork #CAY95 #GiveRiseToPossible #DonateAGift #InvestInOurYouth #YorkPA #TogetherWeRise
